description: Listado de calles de Montevideo con información de numeración, significado, tipo, título, categoría y subcategoría is a dataset listed in City of Montevideo open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Unidad de Nomenclatura y Numeración. Listado de calles de Montevideo con información de numeración, significado, tipo, título, categorías y subcategorías. Los datos se generan diariamente por lo que se tienen los datos actualizados al día anterior. Coverage: Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad de Nomenclatura y Numeración. Its tags are Vías de Montevideo. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, TXT. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is dag-uy. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mvd-portal.
